messages:
elaine (PM): quick sync — putting a first-pass playbook in the doc for the Design Partner pilot. need recruitment copy, success metrics, and clear rollback triggers. aim: 6-week pilot with 6–8 partners across startup + mid-market. link: https://redwood.internal/s/DP-pilot-draft :eyes:
raj (Design Eng): looks good. can we tighten onboarding checklist? worried about wasted seats if partners don't get to first integration within 2 weeks. propose a 'first-success' milestone (sdk call + sample inference) by day 10.
miriam (Customer Success): +1 on milestone. also suggest defining failure modes we can surface to partners (e.g., latency spikes, auth issues). we'll need an SLA expectation doc for Dedicated/private prospects.
alex (Research): for feedback loops, recommend weekly short surveys (3 questions) + one 45min interview every 2 weeks per partner. we should pre-register a set of 10 eval prompts per partner to track regressions.
elaine (PM): agree on milestone and eval set. drafting success criteria: 1) partner integrates SDK and serves 1k tokens/day by week 4 OR 2) partner completes 3 production-like usecases in sandbox. plus qualitative: >=7/10 on 'usefulness' in week 6 survey. thoughts?
sam (Solutions): for recruitment copy, here's a short outreach template: ``Hey <Name> — we’re running a short (6-week) design partner pilot to help shape Redwood Optimize for real inference workloads. You’d get early access, dedicated support, and credits. Looking for teams with 1) infra + product commitment, 2) 2–3 integration engineers, 3) willingness to run weekly check-ins. Interested?``
raj (Design Eng): + template. small ask: include a note about data handling & optional private deployment for regulated data. keeps legal comfortable.
miriam (Customer Success): acceptance criteria for partners: clear internal sponsor, success milestone owner, and weekly engagement slot. if partner misses 2 consecutive check-ins without catching up -> escalate to 'at risk' and offer concierge integration.
elaine (PM): rollout/launch gating thoughts: must-have: onboarding doc, automated onboarding checklist in console, 4 signed partners with NDA, and a runbook for rollbacks (revert routing to hosted variant). nice-to-have: dashboard for partner signal (latency/cost/NPS).
alex (Research): on measurement, add regression alert rules: +5% median latency sustained 30m OR token cost variance >15% for same model/profile -> auto flag, send summary to partner + CS.
onprod-bot: deploy:dp-onboarding-v0 -> success (2026-03-18T16:04Z)
elaine (PM): ops question: can eng-runtime add a debug flag that dumps first 5 inference traces for newly onboarded partners? we can use those for root cause w/out full logs. @raj @eng-runtime fyi.
raj (Design Eng): yes we can. will add `dp_debug=true` gated by partner_id. trace retention 7 days.
miriam (Customer Success): timeline check — recruiting starts next Monday. can design partner ops run a 1-hour onboarding dry run with internal team this Friday? want to catch snags.
sam (Solutions): I can host; will mock two partner personas and walk through the onboarding checklist.
elaine (PM): thanks team — i'll update the doc with these decisions and ping legal for NDA template. next check-in scheduled Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
